name: The Ur-Quan Masters HD MegaMod
tagline: A standalone Mod for The Ur-Quan Masters
blurb: Here you will find The Ur-Quan Masters HD MEGAMOD, a mod that takes the best of the Ur-Quan Master's mods and rolls them up into one big "Mega" mod.
description:
Here you will find The Ur-Quan Masters HD MEGAMOD, a mod that takes the best of the Ur-Quan
Master's mods and rolls them up into one big "Mega" mod. Building upon the latest Ur-Quan
Masters source code I've made an expansive mod which includes HD-mod, HD-Remix,
Nic's Extended mod, and my personal mods which range from quality of life changes and extra
modes to making the HD portions of the game look more faithful to the original design. Though
not everything is going to be perfect and a few things will still stand out.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
